title: KADMON VEIL — THE READING ROOM
intro:
Nine hundred and twenty-two spines.

The early ones are proper vellum. Somewhere in the two hundreds the colour
changes and keeps changing, and by the eight hundreds the pages are grain-husk
fibre, grey, and you can see the ghosts of older reports underneath where the
scraping did not take.

She has been writing on top of herself for sixty years.

Nobody has ever read one. The Attending carries a two-hundred-word summary at
Terce and the reports wait for a courier, bound, indexed, cross-referenced, in
order, on a shelf, for the day somebody comes.

The index is immaculate.
revisit: Nine hundred and twenty-two spines, and an immaculate index.
look:
A room with shelves on four walls and a reading desk in the middle of it.

The REPORTS: nine hundred and twenty-two, bound, numbered, indexed.
The INDEX, on the desk, in a fair hand.
RHOD at the door, who has read all of them twice.

objects.careless: Nine hundred and twenty-two bound reports, numbered, in order, on shelves that were built for them.
objects.careful:
You read three.

**Report 47, cycle 6.** Formal. Faintly irritated.

  *…the tithe for cycles four, five and six has been assembled to grade and
  awaits collection at the Yard. We note that no collection fleet has attended
  and that no acknowledgment of receipt stands against cycles four or five. We
  assume an administrative delay at sector level and have taken no independent
  action. We would be grateful for a corrected collection schedule at the
  Assessor's convenience.*

**Report 415, cycle 44.** Over-documented. Anxiety expressed as completeness.

  *…appended: muster rolls I–XI; shrine attendance; heresy dispositions in
  full, including the Tolliver matter of cycle 34, resolved locally within nine
  days without recourse to sanction; maintenance certificates for all eleven
  reactor housings including the eight that are cold.*

  *I list also what we have not done. We have not reduced the tithe. We have
  not opened the Faithful Armoury. We have not levied against the Owed, though
  the Owed would feed this world for one year and four months. We have not
  despatched an unauthorised vessel. We have not stopped. I record these not as
  complaint but as evidence, in the event that evidence is what is wanted.*

**Report 833, cycle 83.** Flat. Restored to pure form.

  *Report 833. Cycle 83 complete. Tithe assembled to grade and stored.
  Population within tolerance. Heresy nil. Reactors as previously. Nothing
  further to report. O. Vurr, Marchioness, for the Emperor's attention or
  another's.*

The third one is the worst and it takes you a while to work out why, and then
you have it: she has stopped writing to anybody.

[ C12 HELD ]

objects.careless: The index: nine hundred and twenty-two entries, by number, by cycle and by subject, in a fair hand.
objects.careful:
Three ways in. Number, cycle, subject.

The subject index runs to eleven pages and has entries for *Armoury, Faithful, condition of*; *Owed, the, assessed value of*; *Reactor housings, cold, maintenance of*; and *Delay, the, doctrine concerning*, which is cross-referenced to forty-one reports and to the Sub-Deacon's Reading.

It is a working index. It is built to be *used* — to be picked up by somebody who has arrived and needs to find one thing quickly — and it has been maintained and extended for sixty years by a woman who knew perfectly well that the first person to use it would be the first person to read any of it.

She built the finding aid anyway. She built it well.

objects.careless: Report 728, cycle 67. It is one of nine hundred and twenty-two spines and there is nothing to distinguish it.
objects.careful:
One paragraph. It is not addressed to Terra, or to the Assessor, or to the Emperor's attention or another's.

  *To the Adept who opens this.*

  *I do not ask for the fleet. I ask for an acknowledgment in any form. A
  receipt, a number, a mark in the margin of this page in a hand that is not
  mine. My husband died on the ninth of this cycle and I have this morning
  completed his record and vaulted it against the audit, and I find that I
  would like there to be an audit. If there is an Adept, and if this is opened,
  I ask him to make a mark.*

  *O. Vurr.*

The rest of cycle 67 is in perfect form. Report 729 is in perfect form. Every
report after it, for twenty-four years, is in perfect form.

You cannot un-read it.

[ C15 HELD ]

exits.text: Out, with the key to give back.

C12.label: Reports 47, 415 and 833 — sixty years of a loyal world reporting correctly into a wall, and the decay and recovery of the voice doing it
C12.file_text:
FILED. CLASS: COLONIAL / RETURNS, UNTRANSMITTED. INDEXED. WORLD: KADMON VEIL.

The cogitator files all three and cross-references them cleanly against the
world record, which does not resolve, which it notes.

When you open them at Cantica-Null two of the three will be shorter than what
you read in that room, and every cross-reference will still close, and the
seams will not show, because the parts that go are the parts that disagreed
with the record.
C12.note_text:
Three reports, copied by hand over most of a night: 47 at cycle 6, 415 at
cycle 44, 833 at cycle 83.

Irritated, then over-documented, then flat.

*I record these not as complaint but as evidence, in the event that evidence is
what is wanted.*

It is wanted. It took sixty years and it is on grain-husk fibre in my own hand
in my coat, and it is the only documentary proof in the sector that a loyal
world was erased while doing everything correctly.

C728.label: Report 728 — one paragraph, addressed to the Adept who opens this, asking for a mark in the margin
C728.refusal:
FILING TEMPLATE :: CLASS — COLONIAL / RETURNS, UNTRANSMITTED

The template opens and it is the correct template and the fields are the right
fields, and one of them is *disposition*, and the options are acknowledged,
noted, referred and closed.

All four are lies and one of them is the specific lie she asked you not to
tell.

You close the template. There is a stylus in your coat and the report is on a
desk four metres away, and you go back and you make the mark, and you date it,
and it is not evidence of anything and it is not going in a case-file.
C728.note_text:
*I ask for an acknowledgment in any form. A receipt, a number, a mark in the
margin of this page in a hand that is not mine.*

Cycle 67. Her husband died on the ninth.

Every report after it, for twenty-four years, is in perfect form.

I have made the mark. It is a tick and a date and a rosette number in the
margin of Report 728 of Kadmon Veil, and it is the only thing I have done on
this world that was the right size.

strings.no_such_thing: Shelves, a desk, and nine hundred and twenty-two spines.
strings.already_read: You have read it. Reading it again will not improve it.
strings.no_terminal: There is no cogitator in the Reading Room. There is an index.
strings.read_room_locked: It is arranged, by number and by cycle and by subject. She arranged it to be used.
strings.no_one_here: Only Rhod, at the door, who has read all of them twice.
